verdict.rationale: Galileo's docs describe alerts on logs that fire when unexpected things happen, with examples of cost running higher than expected and a model hallucinating more than desired. That covers cost-spike and eval-metric-drop alerting. Nothing in the pack names any notification channel or error-rate alerts. Missing for 10: documented Slack, PagerDuty or email delivery, explicit error-rate alert conditions, threshold/configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
